name: Gameobject Battleground Events
description: Assigns battleground gameobject spawns (by guid) to a battleground event index (main event + sub event, must match a row in battleground_events). Battleground scripts spawn and despawn all objects of an event together when the event becomes (in)active.

fields.name: Event 1
fields.help: Main battleground event id (must exist in battleground_events for the gameobject's map). 255 = BG_EVENT_NONE.

fields.name: Event 2
fields.help: Sub event id (must exist in battleground_events for the gameobject's map). 255 = BG_EVENT_NONE.
